estimates.assumptions: Using the supplied knownGrams value of 350 g exactly as the full edible weight of the shortcrust pastry used to line the 22 cm tart tin (no trimming or waste assumed).

'Dusting' is a modest amount of flour sprinkled on the work surface and rolling pin to prevent sticking; realistically 8-15 g is typical for a single pie crust, so 10 g used here. Copying the supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly.
